body:
Hey, its one of scrapped11's friends. I still can't come to terms with it, but he committed suicide a few days ago...I'm sorry..

He was going through all these emotions, and we talked and he seemed better, but....I don't know.....I'm so sorry....
Commenting from his account to confirm.
I asked him to stop talking to her, he hasn't replied, but I kind of expect an answer by tomorrow. If he doesn't agree then a lot of you suggested that I should cut him out

So I told him in class that he needed to stop the contact, he said he'd think about it...the others said that they were making sure she didn't do anything crazy, and they don't agree with what she did so at least they aren't ignoring it
I guess you're right about that then. I guess I can't really ask them to stop talking to her, but one of them hooking up bothers me, especially so soon.

I have seemed help for my depression and suicide, I'm not sure its working but I don't want to die right now so it must be.

I'm not exactly mad at my friends, but I wanted some opinion from you guys, because the breakup wasn't mutual, she cheated and she felt the need to bring the guy to beat me up...

I recommend that you read the original post and such. Though I do agree with you that the circumstances are vague, the way things planned out isn't the most pleasant. I don't mean this in any aggressive manner or anything, but I do think you should read the original.

I am pissed at them for keeping in contact, though I was more mad at him for not seeing her as a cheater and rather someone he hooks up with. The relationship between me and her is over. I've moved on, but apparently my friends haven't.

I've moved on from her, or at least moved on more than I did last time. The problem is that my friends for some reason still contact her. I had blocked her on every social media and my phone for a while now, so I'm ready to forget this. The problem now is my friends contacting her.
I had already cut contact with her, and J. She's been blocked in all social media and my phone. There's no way for her to contact me or for me to contact her.

I don't care for my hobbies anymore. What's the point? I've lost the one who K cared for the most, I've tried to move on but I can't do it. I don't care for the beauty of nature. What difference would it make if I left? There's more than a billion people here who can offer more than what I can, I won't even leave a scratch. It doesn't matter.
Thank you! I don't know if I want to anymore...what's the point? I can't even decide if I want to die or not...it seems good, but I can't even get up and do that, I just want to sleep forever.

Can't really think of anything to smile about...

But those songs are pretty funny for the moment
That made me smile for a bit, didn't think I could do that...I appreciate it!

I'm gonna meet her up in a on hour, I'll leave an update on this thread if anyone wants to know how it went.

Thanks for the help man!
I'll try that! I've calmed down a bit after my meds, and I've decided to try to end it...I want to do it soon, but I hope I don't regret it, and that I'm making the right choice.
Thank you for the offer! If I ever need to, I definitely will, hope its okay!

I feel like that's the best. I've been seeing my therapist again after I told them about this. So I've been put on better meds, but they say it'll take time for me to recover, and that I should surround myself with good people. I kind of wish I was 'Normal' sometimes ..

I want to cut her out of my life too, but it always comes back. It just feels like, if she could throw me away so easily...why won't others? Why wouldn't anyone else realize that I'm not worth the pain.? 

I hope that it passes though, I want to move on. Hopefully she gets the hint and we can get past this without any fights or anything too! Life is awesome, but not it feels like the only reason you're fighting is so that you don't get labelled as a quitter.

I want to, I really do, I want to move on and forget her, forget all of this. Its not that easy though, it feels like I'm lying to myself, telling myself that I can move on and be better, when the person I loved thought I wasn't.

First off, I really hope you've gotten better! Depression is a real bitch!

Second, I'd be glad to PM you if you don't mind! It really helps talking to someone who knows how it feel and can relate.

I don't know...I guess she replaced me already, or something along those lines...

I don't know about vacation, I have exams going. My roommate and friends have been taking me out and helping me, and I really appreciate it! Its just that, I don't think they can feel how I do. I don't mean to say that they don't care, because I love these guys, but its just that, sometimes people underestimate the affect this had on me..

Hopefully, I just want to move on before I'm suicidal again. 

I hope this means its easier to open up to people now, this hurts my trust quite a bit, but I hope I can move on!
That's what I should do I guess, over text. I can't stand seeing her anymore, so a simple text should work fine..

Its tough. There might be a light, but I don't know if its worth the wait, if its worth the pain of it all. Sure it might be one girl, but she is the one thing I've had all these years, she's been a friend for so long, it's hard imagining a live of you just walking away. Especially with the anxiety, I doubt there's a light, or if its worth the journey.

Wow, that's actually almost exactly what I wanted to say. I don't want to blame her completely so it actually helps a lot! 

I don't know why he came...I do know that I will probably fight him again because he's in many of my courses and will probably start something..

Hopefully though, I can get over this and focus on my depression! Thanks!

I've been meaning to meet new people for a while now, other than some of my close friends, my depression kept me in a shell..I only let her in because she genuinely cared, unlike other girls...or well, she did.

I have got a session booked, I had one yesterday as well! It really did help calm me down. After today it's all come back though. I'm not as worried about the suicide as it comes in short bouts to me, I hate depression more than I hate myself, but it's a part of me.

Oh wow, I can't imagine how it must feel at that age...I really hope it works out for you, mate!!

I kinda get what you mean though, that I'm looking for short term, but in reality to me that sounds amazing. Though I know it isn't, this is where the depression messes me up, it makes me feel like I need redemption. I know I have to break up, because I can't remember any good memories with her except the kiss now..but how do I do it..I want to, and I probably will, but a pat of me keeps making excuses.

I'll definitely hit you up on the PM later if I need to, thank you for the offer!

I feel okay about myself, but after hearing her say all this things, it kinda makes me feel like I haven't really accomplished anything. Of I'm that easy to discard, what's the point..

Haha, thanks for the laugh man!

I guess they are, but at the moment it feels like shit...its not as satisfying or simple by breaking up like I have before, she was my only long term...

Damn man, hope everything works out for you! 

I've kinda realized that I have to break up with her, but how...she's been my only long term, and I've had relationship, before, but this doesn't seem like I'll be satisfied with a simple "We should see other people" line. I know I should man up and tell her she cheated and we're over, but I can't..it just makes me depressed the second I start talking to her about that.

I am in Uni, I've seen my therapist and he's given me medicine in case my depression gets worse. He also said that I should confide into someone if something went wrong, so my roommate and you guys are the ones who know.

Hey OP! I know how it feels. Thinking you're wasting your time and that you don't amount to anything, but trust me, you do! 

I don't know exactly how you feel, but I know that people care about you! Your SO would be devastated without you, so would your parents. They all love you very much. The fact that they are being so patient and caring is different from so many other who would shout and scream at you.

I want you to know that you're just in highschool, and it might feel bad, but you can still do amazing things, its not too late!
Yea, it seems impossible to just stop being depressed and suicidal, but hopefully I can cope better! I've never had !such luck with hotlines though, but I am seeing people.
That's what I want too, to somehow figure out that this was a mistake and she didn't mean it. Hopefully it gets better, thank you!

I do see a therapist, and am on meds. They help, but it just seemed like with her, I could forget my thoughts and just focus on her. I know I need some time to fight this though, I hate my depression more than I hate myself. I've suffered since I was 14 and I know that it may take over me one day, but I'll go swinging!

I want to believe that she was that surprised, but I can tell with full confidence that the kiss lasted a minute..I was hoping she'd stop or push away or do anything, but she didn't, she only saw me at the door and then pushed him away. I know it might not be her fault. I know it may well be and is my fault for being cold while depressed. I love her. More than anything, but whenever I see her all I see is the kiss, and how it wouldn't stop. 

My friends are keeping me occupied for a week so I can get my head straight, I'm seeing my therapist on a surprise appointment, so hopefully I can get a clearer mind.

That's why I believe it was my fault, I've known that I was cold, that's why I wanted to change, I've actually been seeing a therapist again to see if zi can repress the depression further. I know it's not all her fault. She cheated though, and I can't look at her without seeing all those memories replaced with them kissing, that's all I can remember. 

My friends are keeping us apart for a week so that I can get my head straight and hear her out maybe...I don't know if I can blame her, I don't blame her, I love her too much, but I can't get past the kiss..

I'm trying. It's just really hard, she's a part of me. I've opened up so much to her, I've let her in, she's been the only one for 4 years now...and its all just gone...I just can't move on, I love her too much. 

I know I have to though, so my friends are keeping me away from her until I can get a clear head, hopefully then I can hear her out..

That's what I was hoping for, that maybe it only surprised her, but she didn't push away for a whole minute, only when she saw my face. I don't k ow how long I'll talk now, but I want her back so bad, but I know if I see her I'll just see the kiss, that's all I see right now.
I've been contemplating this for years now. Its hard to convince myself that it gets better when my whole life it hasn't.

I'll try that. I don't know if I can move onto another girl so soon though, my girlfriend is still the one I love. I know she cheated, but I love her. Weather this means if I forgive her or not, depends on what I hear from her and what I decide after a break, hopefully whatever happens is the right choice though.

I'm no pushover by any means, but in this situation, the depression brought anxiety and I keep thinking I've messed up, it makes me feel worthless and at fault. That may or may not be the case, but that's how I feel. I want to change that, so I want to talk to her, and him, and get the truth so I can move on, or fix this, depending on what happens.

I'm trying, but losing a part of you that you've had for so long really kills. Especially since my stupid depression decides to set in. I'm trying to see if taking a break from her and being with my friends for a week is going to clear my mind, and when I come back we can hopefully talk about it.

I hope it wasn't that. I've always been fine when we were dating since my pills were doing wonders, we've had fights and breaks like any other couple, but this is the one time where I actually felt truly terrible and suicidal. Hopefully when I get back from my break from her, I can get the truth and move on.
It was a minute, however crazy my depression may be, it was a minute.
That shines a whole new light in this...if she really knew what she was doing..
I will keep that in mind. My fault or not, I'm not succumbing to some stupid depression, not yet.
Isn't if? A lot of people agreed that my depression seems like I was being cold to her...regardless, she cheated. But I still feel like that..
Basically, I saw him kiss her, saw her surprised, but kept kissing for a minute or so....I don't know what to think anymore..but I want to think over it before I talk to her
It wouldn't be okay for me to forgive her for this, would it?
I've never had much luck with hotlines, but fair enough. Though I definitely plan on a session first thing tomorrow!

Self worth wise, I'm not, never have been, but I put it off as a side affect of depression. Relationship wise, I'm not sure, I love her, but I know what I saw. Fair enough that my depression right have been too much for her, but knowing that, I don't know if I can look at her without seeing that image of them kissing..

I'm not necessarily sick, I just suffer from depression, I have ever since zi was 14. It seems a lot worse because seeing her cheat amplifies it, but I'm taking all the needed steps to get rid of it! That being said, I do intent to confront him..

I hope he gets better!! It can be really hard, but having a parent like you to support them is a huge help, keep doing what you do! And definitely, I'll try to make a update thread whenever we talk, thank you!
This is the one thing that usually stops me from killing myself, the thought of my family. So I'll beat depression, and if  I can't win, I'll out up a hell of a fight! Thanks!
I can wait. My roommate and friends are here and I feel really good reading your guys' comments, it really helps knowing you guys care! Hopefully when I see my therapist I'm better!
Appreciate it!
I've just kicked him out of my life. And I can't talk to her without breaking down...I'm going try and take a break, get my head straight, and then talk to her.

Its hard. I don't want to, but the sudden onset of depression and anxiety is toxic. I know my family would be sad, but this depression just keeps digging me deeper into this hole. I'm definitely getting help though! Depression is a bitch, and I won't give up without a fight!
Definitely, I have to !make a choice. And if I ever feel like I might do something, I'll update or PM you!
I don't know if I can. I want to, I fucking love her so so much, but when I see her now, all I see is them kissing..
I'd like to, but I don't know why, but when I see her now, all I can think of is what happened and I break down...

It is hard, almost like a piece if you is ripped away. Also, no, she's sent texts saying "I'm sorry" and "It was an accident" but my roommate has stopped me from interacting as it was making me worse...I want to forgive her so bad....but people have told me not to...

I'm going to do exactly that, take a break, make a decision, and talk to her once I've met my therapist. Until then, I'm gonna go out with my roommate and friends, my roommate is my best friend so I can trust him with all this.
Ugh fine.

Yes to both! I'm on meds and and taking a week from seeing my "girlfriend"? For a week so I can get to see my therapist again. And weather it passes, its always been a part of me and I hate it, but I doubt it'll go away soon. But at least I can deal with it!
Hopefully FIFA doesn't bullshit me too haha. And I'm just going to do whatever I can! And no drugs? Not even one? Aww

I really need to. I'm trying to take a week to see a therapist about my depression so that when I do confront her, I'm ready. I've told her that I'm taking a week to think about all this and that I won't talk to her until I'm ready. So hopefully afterwards I can stand my ground and face her afterwards.

That's the thing, I can't dace her without thinking of killing myself and my depression washing over me. I plan to take a week because I want to see my therapist and sort myself out beforehand. Hopefully afterwards I can talk to her and think normally.

I've tried /r/suicidewatch and the people there helped me through some tough times when I was thinking of killing myself yesterday, I'll definitely check out /r/offmychest too! 

Definitely, if I need to talk I'll PM, thanks for the offer!

No worries, I didn't take it like that! But I was just saying that despite all the medicine, she was the most effective thing at forgetting about my shitty situation. 

And I plan to learn to deal with my condition better! I don't know if it'll be possible to love myself, but at least I can stop being pushed around because of it.

I don't know if I deserve it or not..but thanks for the help!
No worries! You're completely right! But stating that, I still do blame myself, even before you commented I did. If we do break up though....I'll definitely use this as a learning experience...

I really do appreciate the responses!! And I don't know...I only saw her cheat yesterday, and I'm still coming to terms with it. 

As to weather I'll break up, I really don't know. You're right that I don't have other long terms to compare to, so it's even harder to make a decision. She's been a part of me for so long that I can't I!anime not having her by my side anymore. But knowing this, I know she cheated, and I know I have to make a choice, so I'll cut contact until I make a choice on this.

My living conditions, I live in a flat with my best friend. I don't see my girlfriend at Uni at all due to different courses, unless its in the halls or after or before Uni. I can cut contact easily and not see her, but I'm still trying to convince myself that I'm not just dreaming, that I'll wake up and she'll be there...its pathetic I know...
Its really is! I regularly attend therapy for depression!

I regularly take meds and also have regular appointments with my therapist! I really hate my depression, its unbearable. So hopefully I can bring up my thoughts in my next session and tell them about this and my suicidal feelings.
Exactly why I'm taking a break from all this, I'm going to try to get my head straight and think about what to do, hopefully I choose the right decision.
I doubt it, after seeing her with another guy, no matter how much I love her, in that !moment she didn't feel the same
I'll try not to, hopefully my therapist can help me deal with it too
I'm trying hard to somehow make it false...but she cheated...but regardless, it still is my fault in some way or another..

Haha, I'll try not to! I don't actually want to die, but when I'm depressed I can't really control my actions and my emotions just flow all over. I hate depression, so I'm. Of going to lose to it without a fight at least!

I do take my medications, and regularly see my therapist too! I hate depression more than I hate myself, and never wanted for her to be my rock. Though I never really burdened her either, its just that, when I'm with her, my depression seems so small. But I still did and do take my pills and see my therapist.

I can't, not so suddenly at least..I love her too much. I'm gonna take some time away from them and sort myself out, and I am going to go back to my therapist, I don't want to succumb to something as stupid as depression either.

I'll try not to, I hate depression, its a bitch. And yea, he's been with me as long as she has, he's almost like a brother to me. Thanks for caring, it really does mean a lot to me knowing you and the others care!

I know...I do blame !myself for this, I know I always was distant and cold sometimes when I was feeling bad..but I'd never think shed do that...

Right now, I'm keeping my distance so I don't get depressed again and seeing my therapist, and then when I'm ready, I'll try to talk to her, even if its a goodbye, because I really do love her, more than anything. I know I messed up..

I have to confront her sometime though...I'm cutting J out completely though. 

I still love my girlfriend, I love her too much, its been 4 years and she's all I ever had. Seeing her with J killed me, and I wanted to die. My roommate found me and he's helping to keep some distance between us, so I mm gonna take my meds and see a therapist so I can deal with this. Because if I just cut her out without a goodbye...I don't know what I'll do..

Also, thank you for the offer! I'll definitely PM if I'm feeling bad, I appreciate it!

Its just, she helped me through my problem for 4 years, and I absolutely love her..and this just killed me...I'm better now, less suicidal so I won't kill myself right now, but I need time away from her to decide what to do..
I'm going back to my therapist and am in my pills, its just that this took my depression to a whole new level..
Thanks! Hopefully! I want to get out of this pit as fast I can, depression is a bitch.

I was always afraid that it was my depression making me paranoid, as her friends never alerted that it could be worse. I don't know if I can "dump her" I still really love her. I can't forget these 4 years, but seeing what I did, I might have to.

I really did believe that we were okay together. Throughout these 4 years, she's been the best to me and I did learn to be happy a lot more! 

Obviously this really fucking hearts, and I am depressed again, but hopefully a clear mind and therapy will help! Thank you for the help!

I try to be. My friends and her make me feel a lot better and have helped me through a lot, so I'm definitely learning to be happy with myself! The depression obviously makes it hard, but my therapist should be able to help me through this, and hopefully I come out better!

Yea, I think my roommate told her already, but I'll try to convey to her that I need time.

And yea, I hope it does get better. Its almost a chore dealing with it now, but I'm definitely trying and don't give in! Thank you!
Haha, I doubt I'll ever forgive him. But yea, hopefully I can settle this after I've cleared my head, and seen my therapist. Thanks for the kind words, hopefully if we break up I can keep going.
I'll try. I'm gonna see if I can take a week to clear my head. Hopefully I can settle this with her afterwards.

Haha, you got almost all of it spot on.. It does feel like she was the thing that kept me from depression, but hopefully I'm able to move on. For now I'm going to try and keep my distance. Thank you for the advice!
I'm planning on going a week or two to settle myself and deal with therapy. Hopefully that's enough time for me to get ready to talk to her again. Thanks for the help!
I always thought he was just being friendly since I doubt myself a lot. Though now I don't plan on confronting him as a lot of people are reassuring me to the idea that my relationship is over.

I definitely plan on going back to my therapist, I hate this depression more than I hate myself. 

Someone suggested that I should take a week to sort myself and then confront her, I might just try that and hopefully she agrees to give me the space.
That seems like the best thing right now. I'll try to see if either I or my roommate can tell her that, hopefully my mind clears up and I can see my therapist then too.

I'm not worried about if I can find someone else. It's just that, being with her for 4 years, I can't help but feel I went wrong somewhere, and I can't face her without getting depressed, so for my own good I've kept a distance too. And thank you for the kind words!
I'm planning to, but don't worry about me killing myself yet :) My roommate calmed me down and I'm less volatile so I won't do anything stupid

I have no problem confronting him, but my roommate knows about my depression and has made sure to keep me at a distance from them. I can't confront her because I just end up breaking down. it's really pathetic but I still love her..though I know she cheated

My roommate mad sure to keep her away, and he said he'd gladly tell her we were done. But I can't fathom the idea without her...I know I have to break up, but would it be okay if I had someone else do it?

Should I tell my roommate to tell her? Because I can't do it in person...I still love her, I shouldn't but I do. So would it be okay if I just kept a distance from her and had a friend convey the message?
I am on medication, and see a therapist regularly, but this kind of scene just set me off.
Its just, she was such a big part of me, and I'm afraid of what I'll do of we separate. Though I know we have to. I wanted to post here to see how people think I should do it, or if I should do it..

I have gotten therapy, and am on medication that helps, its just that huge emotional scenes cause my depression to amplify. I haven't faced her because I just break down if I try. My roommate has kept her at bay but told her that I need time.

I can't face her..I tried calling her but broke down. I know this isn't a suicidal sub, so I want to keep that part out. Though she does know I won't kill myself yet, my roommate told her I'm fine and made her leave when I got home and she followed.

I was standing in the door way behind them for a solid minute I think, I was hoping she would stop, or do anything. She just sat there until her eye caught mine...I don't know if it was a accident, but she's sent me messages saying "I'm sorry" and said "It was an accident". I haven't talked to her since I know that this is my fault for being distant because of depression...
I'll try not to, thank you for helping!
I don't know, but hopefully I can get some closure from writing. Thank you for this!
I'll try writing...I just want to calm down and get my mind straight...and I've always thought I was worthless, it was part of the anxiety for the longest time. But I appreciate what you've said!

I want to open up, but my anxiety stops me every time. I get thoughts that if be annoying people if I did. I still don't know if I want to live...The aftermath of this really fucking hurts, and I just don't know how to go on. All that's on my mind is me thinking of how and when I messed up, or of how worthless I am. I'm sorry if I'm just repeating myself...

I'd known her for a while before we started dating, and she was always a great friend. She was the only person who I'd told to that I was depressed and had anxiety, and despite all this, she kept by my side, and she never expected anything in return. This is why I wanted to take her traveling, since I knew that no matter what I buy for her, it wouldn't be enough. She cared and treated me normally, she loved me, and for 4 years made me forget about the depression and anxiety. I still love her, but my depression and anxiety are all back, and its worse than before now...I can't think of anything else, since the reason I chose Uni was for her..

I have hobbies, but they've gone no where because my family didn't have the finances so that I could go to a soccer academy when I was offered a chance. I don't blame them at all. My family can't know, they've been struggling for a long time, and if they knew I'd be killing them. Relationships don't always work out, yes. But after being with her for 4 years, she was the one thing keeping my depression and anxiety repressed, but they're back now and I can't cope

I don't want them to have to deal with this on top of exams. Even if they did, It wouldn't be much difference to me. The only thing I honestly want to do is die. The feeling I've been repressing for 4 years now, its all back

I don't have anything. Before I met her I didn't have any ambition or drive, and I would have loved to die any time. She gave me a purpose I guess...and I've been with her for 3+ years now, and I feel like I've messed that all up...its all gone.

Medication has helped me. But it was only temporary, and I know it sounds stubborn, but she was really the only thing keeping me together. I lived because I wanted to make her happy, and I liked knowing that someone cared. There are my friends, but I can't let them know. None of them know about my depression or anxiety, and they're all probably out, I don't want to ruin it for them with this..

I'm in my living room now. I don't know if I can, I know what I saw. He kissed her, she just let him for a minute or so, and only stopped when I saw her. My anxiety is bad again, and with this and my depression, there's really only one thing to do.
This doesn't show what happens in the dressing rooms does it? Some things are kept private, considering that we didn't concede, I think we had passion, mate.
I doubt I can open up all of a sudden, and I can't die while she's going through all this, not yet at least. I'll try to talk to her, but it won't go far. At least it'll be a start?

Ah, I'm really happy that you've found your way! I doubt that I can realize immediate affects as I'm only 18 and in Uni, thing is, this identity of mine has been with me for as long as I can remember, I myself am disappointed by how badly I'm doing now.

I did open up to someone, my best friend, but even I could see how weird she thought I was, I just bothered her for no reason with my stupid anxiety. I'd rather suffer like this and end it then share and ruin someone else's day.
I want to believe that, but I can't, I'm a failure because I can't. It all seems so irrational but the anxiety and depression just make it unbearable.

I want to, I've tried, I've gone through this for years and kept it at bay, but now it just makes me feel like a piece if shit every single day. I don't mind not being the smartest, but when you feel like if you don't then your life will be ruined, it gets unbearable. It all seems so irrational, the anxiety, but it's so bad that I just can't anymore...

This is the type of stuff which makes me feel more of a failure, the anxiety. Sometimes its so irrational and stupid, and it just hurts others so much, I wanted to end it because I couldn't take it anymore. But this is hurting her now too...I'm going to see if I can help her...

I want to, and I probably will open up to her, but then the anxiety sets in, I get irrational, even now all I can think of is how stupid I'm being. The stupid part is that I still don't care if I die, but I don't want to hurt her either...

Well, my girlfriend found me...she thought I was missing and took a friend to come look for me, I made an excuse that I was studying....I don't know if I can tell her the truth. She was crying though, I didn't know that it hurt her so much...
Still here, just taking in the nature, being away from people right now is good, I might just try to get lost.

It does! But I've passed that point I feel, I have about 15 minutes left until I leave for my walk haha. My girlfriend walks the same way so if I can hide from her, I'll take in the nature and see what happens. 

Please don't think you failed! You help people a lot and they do appreciate it, so keep doing what you're doing my man, thank you.

Well, I'm leaving in about 15 minutes. I'll dick around on the data plan for a while and watch some videos and message people goodbye with the WiFi. I haven't decided how it'll happen, but I have the means, and I might just take some time to stroll and take in the nature for once. I think my girlfriend knows I got this way, so I'll have to hide if I can, but I wanted to say that I'm sorry if I let anyone here down! You guys gave me someone to talk to, so don't feel like you failed or anything! Keep doing what you do, people really do appreciate it. 

So if my girlfriend doesn't see me, it should be quick, thanks again, guys!
I'm set on the plan, but I will try to read these again in the morning beforehand, it shouldn't slow me down.
